---
title: Body classes override
format: q2-preview
body-classes: custom-cls
_quarto:
  tests:
    run:
      requires_js: true
    q2-preview:
      ensureHtmlElements:
        -
          - 'body.custom-cls'
        -
          - 'body.fullcontent'
---

A paragraph; the iframe body carries the user `body-classes` override
and does NOT also carry the literal `fullcontent` default.
